comment: The resource configuration of the durable research controller (issue #107). Every cap here is enforced before a dispatch, and the controller refuses rather than exceeding one.

prohibitions.multi_seed: refused by guardrails.py: the seed must be 42
prohibitions.control_retrain: refused by guardrails.py: the control is evidence
prohibitions.archived_policy_rerun: refused by guardrails.py: the archived policies are read-only
prohibitions.failed_arm_rerun: refused by guardrails.py: a failed arm is classified, never retried
prohibitions.renamed_mechanism: refused by guardrails.py: the specification digest, not the name, decides
prohibitions.repeated_frozen_evaluation: refused by guardrails.py: the ER is read once per arm
prohibitions.repeated_stage3: refused by guardrails.py: Stage-3 is read once per arm
